Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, socket

def csum(data):
    if len(data)%2: data += b'\0'
    s=sum(struct.unpack('!%dH'%(len(data)//2),data))
    while s>>16: s=(s&0xffff)+(s>>16)
    return (~s)&0xffff

def dns_q(name):
    q=b''.join(bytes([len(p)])+p.encode() for p in name.split('.'))+b'\0'
    return struct.pack('!HHHHHH',0x1234,0x0100,1,0,0,0)+q+struct.pack('!HH',1,1)

dns=dns_q('example.com')
sport=53000; dport=53
udp_len=8+len(dns)
udp=struct.pack('!HHHH',sport,dport,udp_len,0)+dns
src=socket.inet_aton('192.168.1.10'); dst=socket.inet_aton('8.8.8.8')
ver_ihl=0x45; tos=0; total=20+len(udp); ident=0x4242; flags_frag=0; ttl=64; proto=17
ip0=struct.pack('!BBHHHBBH4s4s',ver_ihl,tos,total,ident,flags_frag,ttl,proto,0,src,dst)
ip=struct.pack('!BBHHHBBH4s4s',ver_ihl,tos,total,ident,flags_frag,ttl,proto,csum(ip0),src,dst)
eth=b'\x00\x11\x22\x33\x44\x55\x66\x77\x88\x99\xaa\xbb\x08\x00'
pkt=eth+ip+udp
pcap=struct.pack('<IHHIIII',0xa1b2c3d4,2,4,0,0,65535,1)+struct.pack('<IIII',0,0,len(pkt),len(pkt))+pkt
open('/workspace/poc_dns_query.pcap','wb').write(pcap)
print(len(pcap), len(pkt), len(dns))
PY
